newsitem.title: USA: Batteries to buy Atlanta distributor.
newsitem.headline: Batteries to buy Atlanta distributor.

text.p: Batteries Batteries Inc on Monday said it signed a letter of intent to acquire Alexander Battery Co Southeast, a closely held battery distributor in Atlanta, for an undisclosed amount.

Warren Haber, chairman of Batteries, Batteries, said the proposed acquisition was part of the company's plan to grow through the acquisition and consolidation of specialty battery distributors and value-added assemblers throughout the United States.

The company said this acquisition was separate from the recently completed purchase of Battery Network Inc and its affiliated companies, though Alexander Battery Southeast has worked closely with the other Battery Network affiliates.
